is_anopheles.evidence: The study tested Anopheles funestus mosquitoes (page 1, Title and Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study genotyped CYP6P9a_R, CYP6P9b_R, and the intergenic 6.5 kb structural variant (6.5 kb SV) (page 4, section 2.2; page 16, section 4.6).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Genotype counts and odds ratios for alive vs dead and blood-fed vs unfed mosquitoes are reported in Figures 2-7 and throughout the text.

african_field_population.evidence: The study exclusively used laboratory colonies and their crosses (F5 generation progeny of a reciprocal cross between the FUMOZ lab colony from Mozambique and the FANG lab colony from Angola) for release-recapture in experimental huts (page 13, section 4.2).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical experimental hut and bioassay study.

sub_country_location.evidence: Experimental hut trial was performed in Mibellon village, Adamawa region, Mayo Banyo division, Cameroon (6°4'60'' N, 11°30'0'' E) (page 13, section 4.1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The experimental hut trial was carried out in August 2017 (page 13, section 4.1).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a specific release-recapture experimental hut trial using laboratory cross progenies.

supplement.evidence: Supplementary files S1-S5 are mentioned in text, but eligibility determination is complete based on the main text confirming the sole use of lab strains.

assessment.summary: This paper evaluates the impact of P450 resistance markers (CYP6P9a, CYP6P9b, and 6.5 kb SV) on the efficacy of Olyset and Olyset Plus nets in experimental hut trials in Mibellon, Cameroon. However, all genotyped mosquitoes were laboratory colony hybrids (F5 progeny of FUMOZ x FANG), making the study ineligible as it does not test an African field population.
exclusion_reasons: Only laboratory colony crosses (FUMOZ-FANG hybrid strain) were genotyped, failing the requirement for African field populations.
